P.note: Clearly blue and legible with a bloomed sky, but the grass is cartoonish hills and the card reads as a generic blue frosted panel.

Q.note: Strong overexposed blue-white plate and electric grass, but the previous and next buttons render as blank circles with no icons, so required transport parts are missing.

R.note: Electric green grass tufts, saturated sky with bloom, and floating glass bubbles give the most convincing Frutiger Aero read, though the mint-tinted queue and navy-on-blue title soften the material illusion.

S.note: The translucent card is effective, but the top brand text and equalizer bars wash out into the white header and are nearly invisible.

T.note: The translucent vinyl artwork and complete controls are solid, but the blue frosted card and flat hills feel more like a familiar glass template than material-lit color.

U.note: Blue-tinted overexposed whites, a lit acrylic rim, and crisp navy-on-pale text make the color feel inside the material, with every control present and readable.
